items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Chester Chapp was his name. Yeah. But what I'm saying is, you were talking about community and things and different things like that. With a musician, he's more or less -- I don't know them all, but I know in my position you become like a doctor or consultant or -- the whole bit.

ctx.x: Yeah, out of the funeral parlor into the -- what's the name, into the hearse. And after that, then he told us, he says, now, I want all of you to go over to the Greek restaurant over there, and just eat, drink and have a ball on me. And he said, -- but the way he originally wanted it, he wanted us to march from the funeral parlor to in front of his place over on State Street, there, and then with the band and just be playing in the street. He says, because I want them to know old Chester went out swinging.
